name: TerraFund for AFR100

administered_by.name: World Resources Institute, One Tree Planted, Realize Impact and Barka

summary: Grants, loans and equity for locally led nonprofits and enterprises restoring land with trees in Africa, with training and satellite monitoring. After earlier open calls, it now invites selected organisations in target landscapes.
reporting: Projects set targets, record the location of each site and report their impact on people and nature every six months.

administered_by.quote: TerraFund for AFR100 is managed by World Resources Institute, One Tree Planted, Realize Impact, and Barka in support of the AFR100 Initiative.

applicant_types.quote: That is why a group of ambitious donors have capitalized TerraFund for AFR100 to finance the top 100 African non-profit community organizations and for-profit businesses that are restoring trees to suitable African landscapes.

geography.quote: TerraFund's portfolio has grown to include hundreds of local organizations across Africa

access.quote: After running open calls for proposals to build pipeline, TerraFund now invites promising organizations into an intensive co-creation process, maximizing biodiversity, water, and livelihood outcomes in the targeted areas.

amount.quote: They will provide funding of $50,000 to $500,000 in the form of grants and loans to each of these innovators.

reporting.quote: Projects set targets, collect the locations of each site, and report their impact on people and nature every six months.
